# Arav Innovations

> Enterprise IT Strategy, Full-Stack Engineering, Digital Marketing, Risk & Governance, and Staff Augmentation Globally.

## Overview
Arav Innovations is a multidisciplinary technology consulting and engineering firm operating across India (Gurugram) and the UAE (Dubai). We help enterprises, scale-ups, and organizations modernize technology infrastructure, build scalable web and mobile software, achieve regulatory compliance (DPDP, ISO 27001, GDPR), and accelerate digital market growth.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **IT Strategy & Implementation**: Enterprise cloud roadmaps, architecture modernization, IT governance.
  - URL: https://aravinnovations.com/services/it-strategy-implementation
- **Web & Application Development**: Scalable React/Next.js web apps, microservices, cloud APIs, mobile platforms.
  - URL: https://aravinnovations.com/services/web-app-development
- **Digital Marketing & Brand Development**: Demand generation, brand positioning, performance marketing.
  - URL: https://aravinnovations.com/services/digital-marketing-brand-development
- **Risk, Compliance & Governance**: DPDP readiness, ISO 27001, GDPR compliance frameworks, SOC 2.
  - URL: https://aravinnovations.com/services/risk-compliance-governance
- **Audit & Technical Improvement**: Architecture reviews, code audits, performance optimization blueprints.
  - URL: https://aravinnovations.com/services/audit-improvement
- **Training & Staff Augmentation**: Pre-vetted senior engineering talent and capability building.
  - URL: https://aravinnovations.com/services/training-staff-augmentation
- **SEO Services**: Technical crawlability, search architecture, organic growth engineering.
  - URL: https://aravinnovations.com/services/seo-services
- **AI Portfolio**: Practical enterprise AI integration, agentic AI engines, workflow automation.
  - URL: https://aravinnovations.com/services/ai-portfolio
